method: Read each indexed resource with GameSource, verify its raw SHA-256, decompress where recorded, and call sn3_vm.verify_script with its indexed pool rows.
checks: Every indexed resource matches its recorded raw source hash
Instructions decode from byte 32 to the string-pool boundary
Entrypoints and all decoded call/jump targets are instruction boundaries
All text references resolve to indexed string starts or the empty pool base
Every indexed nonempty string has an instruction reference
limitations: Command meanings, speakers, scene order, and branch context need mapping
Encoding and relocation have static checks, but no script relocation build or expanded runtime allocation proof exists
This validates the indexed scripts, not full-game text coverage or a translated playthrough
